evidence.says: LC identifies Iglesias Prieto, Norma, links directly to Q112194440, and records birth year 1959. Its source note for Beautiful flowers of the maquiladora (1997) cites a publisher data sheet and curriculum vitae, both supporting 1959; it also cites La visión de la frontera a través del cine mexicano (1985).

The project’s saved Wikidata SPARQL result for n86125049 identifies Q112194440 as human, labels it Norma Iglesias-Prieto, gives P244 n86125049 and birth year 1986. Live item, entity-data and query requests returned HTTP 403, so further item statements and birth references could not be inspected.
The graph’s Open Library author lists Beautiful flowers of the maquiladora (1997) and La visión de la frontera a través del cine mexicano (1985), matching LC’s source works, as well as Emergencias.

SDSU identifies Norma Iglesias Prieto as professor emerita, a scholar of border cultural studies, gender, art and cinema, and author of Beautiful Flowers of the Maquiladoras and Emergencias. The same faculty page is cited in LC’s authority record.

notes: Identity is supported by the matching name, reciprocal LC–Wikidata identifiers and matching works across LC, Open Library and SDSU. The 1986 birth year conflicts with LC’s data-sheet/CV evidence for 1959 and the documented academic career beginning in 1982. Wikidata’s live birth source remains unverified because of HTTP 403; item evidence uses the existing saved query.
